editorial.description_en: Well past dusk. The darkest colour here that still argues it is a blue and not a black.
editorial.description_ja: 夜がふけたころのような、いちばん濃い青紫。
editorial.contemporaryNote_en: Offered as the alternative to black in the Indigo palette. It reads as black at a glance and as blue beside anything neutral, which is the property the palette is built on.

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.268, C 0.090, h 278.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 深 (fuka, deep) + 宵 (yoi, early night). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Deep Night" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 深宵. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — hoshi-nashi at ΔE00 4.8, shizumi-ao at ΔE00 5.9, samu-boshi at ΔE00 7.9. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (98°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
